oldContent: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Datadog: Senior Developer Advocate, OpenTelemetry USA Only Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7075/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> California, USA, Remote; Massachusetts, USA, Remote; New York, USA, Remote; Washington, USA, Remote <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://careers.datadoghq.com">https://careers.datadoghq.com</a> </p> <p>Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with practitioners across the community, customers and non-customers alike. Our Senior Developer Advocates are technical leaders and mentors who own projects, connect teams, and help engineers solve real-world challenges.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll build on Datadog’s established work in OpenTelemetry (OTel), working alongside engineers who build and maintain components of the project and fellow community members. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with advocacy, bringing the challenges developers face into the project, sharing what you learn, and helping others contribute. It’s an opportunity to deepen your impact in OTel while strengthening the tools, shared knowledge, and community that everyone builds on.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Datadog’s product and engineering teams to turn feedback from OTel users and contributors into product improvements, and bring proposed changes back to the community for discussion and feedback.</li> <li>Contribute to OTel through code, reviews, documentation, and working groups, collaborating with maintainers and helping new participants get involved.</li> <li>Explore instrumentation and observability in AI applications and agentic workflows, using hands-on work to inform upstream development, product improvements, and practical guidance for developers.</li> <li>Create technical content in the formats that best serve the community, drawing on hands-on work and the challenges practitioners encounter.</li> <li>Partner with and coach engineers and community members to share In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion.</p></li><li><p><strong>Strategic account planning:</strong> Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability.</p></li><li><p><strong>Drive executive value:</strong> Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.</p></li><li><p><strong>Operational excellence:</strong> Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.</p></li><li><p><strong>Cross-functional advocacy:</strong> Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Beyond the basics, what will make you successful:</strong></p><ul><li><p><strong>Extreme ownership</strong>: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.</p></li><li><p><strong>Extreme curiosity</strong>: You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause.</p></li><li><p><strong>Scrappiness</strong>: You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress.
